futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2023 Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2023 Predictions

entries.quote: By 2027, Over 50% of IT Budgets in Most G500 Enterprises Will Be Allotted to Connectivity, Security, Compute, and Data Assets Used to Deliver Their Own as-a-Service Processes and Smart Products
entries.subject: IT budgets for as-a-service assets
entries.metric: share of IT budgets in G500 enterprises allotted to assets for own as-a-service processes and smart products

entries.quote: In 2025, 60% of Infrastructure, Security, Data, and Network Offerings Will Require Cloud-Based Control Platforms That Enable Extensive Automation and Promise Major Reductions in Ongoing Operating Costs
entries.subject: Cloud-based control platforms
entries.metric: share of infrastructure, security, data and network offerings requiring cloud-based control platforms

entries.quote: Through 2024, Shortcomings in Critical Skills Creation and Training Efforts by IT Industry Leaders Will Prevent 65% of Businesses from Achieving Full Value from Cloud, Data, and Automation Investments
entries.subject: IT skills shortfall
entries.metric: share of businesses prevented from full value from cloud, data and automation

entries.quote: Sovereign Assertions in Sustainability, Resiliency, and Asset Residency Through 2025 Will Force G2000 CIOs to Shift Staff, Budgets, and Operating Processes for More than 35% of IT and Data Assets
entries.subject: Digital sovereignty
entries.metric: share of IT and data assets for which G2000 CIOs shift staff, budgets and processes

entries.quote: In 2023, 70% of Enterprises' Adoption of as-a-Service Infrastructure/Software Will Be Curbed More by an Inability to Assess Promises of Faster Innovation and Operational Gains than by Cost Concerns
entries.subject: As-a-service adoption barriers
entries.metric: share of enterprises whose aaS adoption is curbed more by inability to assess promises than by cost

entries.quote: By the End of 2024, 60% of Platinum-Level aaS Offerings in Security, Business Operations, and DaaS Will Include Bundled Access to Specialized SME Teams to Help Reduce Impact of Skills Shortages
entries.subject: SME teams bundled in aaS offerings
entries.metric: share of platinum-level aaS offerings including specialized SME teams

entries.quote: In 2025, 20 High-Visibility Digital Product Launches Reliant on Intelligent Automation and aaS Delivery Will Face Major Delays Due to Global or Regional Silicon and Code Supply Chain Issues
entries.subject: Silicon and code supply chain delays
entries.metric: number of high-visibility digital product launches facing major delays

entries.quote: Through 2026, 55% of Enterprises Attempting to Use Tech-by-Wire Offerings Will Still Struggle with a Proliferation of Siloed Control Systems That Raise Connectivity Costs and Limit Sharing of Data
entries.subject: Tech-by-wire control silos
entries.metric: share of enterprises struggling with siloed control systems

entries.quote: In 2026, 45% of G2000 Enterprises Will Continue to Face Material Risks Due to Frontline Workers' and Business Leaders' Unwillingness to Trust Actions Initiated by Vetted Autonomous Tech Systems
entries.subject: Trust in autonomous systems
entries.metric: share of G2000 enterprises facing material risks from distrust of autonomous tech

entries.quote: By 2027, the Ability to Deploy and Use Machine Vision as an Inherent Capability in Any New Product/Process Will Be a Primary Characteristic of the Five Fastest-Growing Enterprises in Most Industries
entries.subject: Machine vision
entries.note: No number beyond 'five fastest-growing enterprises in most industries'.

entries.quote: By 2025, 70% of CIOs Will Find Their Roles Being Challenged by LOB Counterparts Who Better Demonstrate the Ability to Align Technology with the Organization's Mission and Customers
entries.subject: CIO role challenged by LOB
entries.metric: share of CIOs whose roles are challenged by LOB counterparts

entries.quote: By 2025, 60% of CIOs Will Increase Their Reach and Impact by Effectively Governing "Pervasive IT" Spanning LOBs and Ecosystem Partners and Optimizing Services from the Best Contributors
entries.subject: Pervasive IT governance
entries.metric: share of CIOs governing pervasive IT

entries.quote: To Address the Increasing Volatility of Market and Customer Needs, by 2026, 60% of CIOs Will Use Operating Model Design to Optimize Value Stream, Agile Architecture, and Risk Management
entries.subject: Operating model design
entries.metric: share of CIOs using operating model design

entries.quote: By 2024, 65% of CIOs Will Actively Harness Resilience Capabilities as a Competitive Advantage to Deliver Financial, Supply Chain, Ecosystem, and Sustainability Differentiation
entries.subject: Resilience as competitive advantage
entries.metric: share of CIOs harnessing resilience capabilities

entries.quote: Through 2025, Only 45% of CIOs Will Achieve a True Intelligent Enterprise That Blends AI/ML and Deep Automation with Speed and Scale to Monetize Changing Business Environments
entries.subject: Intelligent enterprise
entries.metric: share of CIOs achieving a true intelligent enterprise

entries.quote: To Cope with Skills Shortages, Labor Needs, and Work That Is Beyond Human Abilities, by 2026, 75% of CIOs Will Broadly Augment Critical Systems with Embedded Intelligence and Automated Technologies
entries.subject: Embedded intelligence and automation
entries.metric: share of CIOs augmenting critical systems with embedded intelligence

entries.quote: By 2025, 70% of CIOs Will Rely More on Operational Data and Information Collected on the "Edge," as Businesses Look to Act on Multiple Source Real-Time Data for Faster Decision Making
entries.subject: Edge operational data
entries.metric: share of CIOs relying more on edge operational data

entries.quote: By 2024, 40% of CIOs Will Be Tasked with Using Technology Ethically to Gain Insight into Employee Experience and Their Perceptions of the Company's Offerings and to Enable Them to Amplify the Brand
entries.subject: Ethical employee insight technology
entries.metric: share of CIOs tasked with ethical use of technology for employee insight

entries.quote: Through 2027, 80% of CIOs Will Provide Governance in Selecting "Clean" Information Technology, Holding Partners Accountable, and Managing Systems with Sustainability Metrics
entries.subject: Sustainable IT governance
entries.metric: share of CIOs governing selection of clean IT

entries.quote: By 2025, with 40% or More of IT Spending as a Service, Use of Short Duration Capex Cutting Tactics Will be Constrained, Instead Requiring Lasting Opex Resets of 10–30% in Software and Resources
entries.subject: Opex resets in IT spending
entries.metric: size of lasting opex resets in software and resources
entries.note: Condition: 40% or more of IT spending as a service.
